headline: Weathered Expanse Flares as Callahans Post Changes Hands
war_summary: Since the 06:10 edition fresh entries appear in Callahans Passage with two changes at Crumbling Post to 08:15, holdings standing at nine Warden to one Colonial with day losses of 8,220 Colonial and 7,000 Warden and heavy short-hour rates, while the Weathered Expanse has quickened to four changes in two hours, ten in six and forty-one in the day around Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk to 08:25, holdings now one Warden, seven Colonial and one destroyed with day losses of 9,870 Colonial and 10,647 Warden. Palantine Berm is quiet the last two hours after three changes in six and eleven in the day at Leiri Hermanni and The Droll to 05:33, still six Warden to one Colonial with accelerating short-hour casualties. Mooring County shows no changes in two hours after thirty-one in the day to 03:57, still eleven Warden to one Colonial, and Stlican Shelf is quiet the last six hours after fourteen day changes to 02:34 at four Warden to five Colonial, with Nevish Line reporting no fresh flips since 21:55.
